title: Censoring-aware replenishment decision-support system (code)
description: Code for the paper A censoring-aware decision-support system for perishable replenishment: turning latent demand recovery into service-level-optimal ordering. The system recovers latent demand from hourly stockout labels, forecasts its distribution with global LightGBM quantile models, converts it into critical-fractile orders at the planner's cost and shelf-life settings, and evaluates the decisions against known demand in a semi-synthetic world built from FreshRetailNet-50K, with a transfer experiment on M5. python run_all.py reproduces every result on a CPU.
